hypothesis: A capitulation/reclaim effect, if structural rather than BTC-specific, should survive a volatility-normalized shock definition with one common parameter set across BTC, ETH and SOL.
derivation_disclosure: V20 is explicitly derived after v19 produced an attractive but under-sampled BTC-only result. It does not reuse the v19 winning point. The full common grid is frozen around volatility-normalized shocks, removes the asset selection axis and requires all three assets to contribute positively.

data_contract.input: checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC H1; no volume rules
data_contract.shock_normalization: absolute close-to-close shock divided by prior ATR14, common across assets
data_contract.signal_time: completed H1 bars only; next complete H1 open entry
data_contract.proxy_limitation: No promotion before native Ostium coverage and parity

execution_contract.shock: long setup: close change <= -shock_close_atr times prior ATR and true range >= range_atr times prior ATR; short symmetric
execution_contract.reclaim: first close through frozen 50/75% shock-bar level within 1/2/3 hours
execution_contract.entry_exit: next H1 open; shock-time ATR stop or 2/6/12-bar close
execution_contract.universal_rule: identical parameters on BTCUSD, ETHUSD and SOLUSD
execution_contract.portfolio_scheduler: sort by entry time and asset; accept at most two concurrent 1%-risk positions; later simultaneous signals are skipped
execution_contract.boundary_policy: skip any trade whose full registered holding cannot finish inside its evaluated period

stability.representative: graph medoid of largest stable component without performance metrics

small_account.leverage_rule: Highest venue leverage whose liquidation distance is at least 1.25 times the stop distance.

family_stop_rule.stop_after_internal_walk_forward_if: zero representatives pass all aggregate, per-asset, per-fold and drop-one gates
family_stop_rule.global_holdout_policy: Survivors enter a final-cohort waitlist; no family-level holdout release.
family_stop_rule.sqcli_policy: SQ reproduction on consumed periods only after internal survival; never a promotion by itself.
